# OnDeck Releases Q3 2026 Small Business Cash Flow Trend Report


November 3, 2026


Ninety-three percent of small business owners expect growth over the next year, and 68% are on track to meet or beat their 2026 profit plan, according to the latest Small Business Cash Flow Trend Report from OnDeck, a market leader in small business lending, and Ocrolus, an AI workflow and cash flow analytics platform for lenders.


Read more in the[full report](https://www.ondeck.com/small-business-trends#Q3) and[press release](https://ir.enova.com/2026-11-03-New-Report-93-of-Small-Businesses-Expect-Growth-as-AI-Delivers-Measurable-Results) .
